pred_texts: Instruct: Get a large pan and put it on the stove.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add one tablespoon of oil to the pan.
Instruct: Now turn on the stove to medium heat.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now, while the pan is heating up, get one chicken breast and wash it.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now, cut the chicken breast into small pieces that cook easily.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now put the chopped chicken chunks into the pan.
Instruct: Now season with salt and pepper. You can add salt and pepper according to your taste.
Instruct: Now cook the chicken for about six to seven minutes. You should stir occasionally to prevent the chicken from burning.
Instruct: Now you can set the heat to low.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now get another medium sized pan.
Instruct: Now add two tablespoons of oil to the pan.
Instruct: Now break two eggs into the pan.
Instruct: Now turn on the heat to medium on pan with the eggs.
Instruct: Now wait about two minutes until the oil heats up. You can turn up the heat if it is taking too long.
Instruct: Now start scrambling the eggs until they are semi-soft, about three to four minutes.
Instruct: Now put the semi-soft scrambled eggs into the pan with the chicken.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now you can turn off the heat of the empty pan.
Instruct: Now add two cups of cooked rice into the pan with the chicken.
Instruct: Now set the heat to medium and stir all the ingredients in the pan until they're well mixed.
Instruct: Now add one teaspoon of garlic paste to the mixture.
Instruct: Now stir the garlic paste together with the other ingredients in the pan until they're well mixed.
Instruct: Now add three tablespoons of soy sauce to the mixture.
Instruct: Now stir the ingredients in the pan until they are well mixed with the soya sauce.
